$comment: Multi-APK baseline manifest for GATOR parity gates. Pins one entry per
APK that the parity suites parametrize over. The MANIFEST itself lives
in baselines/ but Tier-1 (cryptoapp) keeps the legacy file location
modules/rv-static-analysis/tests/resources/cryptoapp.apk.json so the
existing parser unit suite + parity gate do not have to be rewired in
the same change.
Each entry MUST be regenerated when (a) the deployed jar at
lib/gator/rvsec-analysis-client.jar changes, (b) the APK referenced by
apk_path changes, or (c) the JSON schema (gh57 components, gh60 keys,
ADR-6 sentinel) evolves. The regeneration recipe is documented in
openspec/changes/gh60-targets-core/tasks.md task 11.8.
apk_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the APK file. The fixture loader hashes
the local file before running GATOR — if the on-disk APK does not
match, the test must FAIL (when RV_GATOR_REQUIRED=1) or SKIP loudly
(otherwise). Pinning the hash defends against silently-different APKs
in mixed JOAO/APKs / apks_examples search paths.
expected_metrics is the load-bearing invariant. The parity test asserts
set-equality on the (reachable, reachesTarget, directlyReachesTarget)
signature sets — these counts are the human-readable sanity envelope
that surfaces when the engine drifts. They are NOT the gate; the gate
is the per-signature set in the baseline JSON.
cg_algorithm pins the CG algorithm used during regeneration. After the
gh51 D5 switch to spark, all production sweeps and gates MUST run spark.
If a future entry needs a different algorithm (e.g. cha for a specific
limitation reproduction), it MUST be recorded here so the regenerator
respects it.
Tier-2 expansion (planned, NOT in this change) adds 4 more APKs from
the JCA-400 corpus covering: pure-Java legacy, Compose/Kotlin modern,
R8-shrunk, and multi-component (Service+Receiver+Provider). See gh60
design.md §D12 follow-up notes.

entries.name: cryptoapp
entries.why_chosen: Controlled toy. Source tree available in examples/cryptoapp/. Exercises the JCA target detection path (3 methods: MessageDigestUtil.hash, CipherUtil.aes, CipherUtil.des — all directlyReachesTarget=True under current spark default). Validates the baseline mechanism itself (schema + sentinel + key naming) before adding behavioral diversity in Tier-2.
